edit.summary:
I made three proposals in the `authoring` domain and left `delivery` unchanged. All three are proposed, not confirmed, and each came back with 0 issues.

- **`objects.Commit`** (E-16-a0685c52): I added an optional text property, `release_name`. Every other property is as before.
- **`actions.name_release`** (E-16-35174375): this is a new action for the owner on a Commit. It takes a `release_name` and stores it on the commit. Its precondition `approved-to-name` allows it only on an approved commit.
- **`transitions.Commit`** (E-16-e4b3f4e1): I added a `name_release` cell to the `recorded` stage, so naming leaves the commit in `recorded`. The existing cells are unchanged.

The request didn't say whether a release name can be changed once it's set, so the action allows renaming. It also doesn't say whether names must be unique. I added no uniqueness rule.
